name: Visual-guided AI video app with 3D camera control

mentions.name: Visual-guided AI video app with 3D camera control
mentions.description: This app lets users produce videos with generative AI by providing visual clues as guides, and offers a 3D environment where the camera can be freely manipulated within the generated scene, making the AI video creation workflow more intuitive.
mentions.problem: Generative AI video results are close to but rarely capture the exact vision, and prompting the AI to fix specific details is cumbersome and time-consuming.
mentions.audience: Creative workflow around producing videos with generative AI.
mentions.source_excerpt: So far, I’ve built an app that allows users to provide visual clues as guides, along with a 3D environment where the camera can be freely manipulated within the generated scene.

evidence.value: So far, I’ve built an app that allows users to provide visual clues as guides, along with a 3D environment where the camera can be freely manipulated within the generated scene.
